title: Old English dictionary
edition: J. R. Clark Hall · A Concise Anglo-Saxon Dictionary · second edition, 1916
notes: A later scholarly dictionary of this historical language, not a dictionary compiled during that language period. Entry wording, alternative forms, senses, examples, and abbreviations are kept together; HTML whitespace is normalized. Cross-references and cited material may need consultation of the original.
